config.label: Identify your own client
config.description: Identify your own client. The project's own identifier is appended, so the Library can always reach a human.

config.label: Minimum milliseconds between requests
config.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 6000, floor 3000.

config.label: Deadline for one catalogue, record or collection request, in milliseconds
config.description: Deadline for one catalogue, record or collection request, in milliseconds. Default 30000.

config.label: Deadline for one search_newspapers request, in milliseconds
config.description: Deadline for one search_newspapers request, in milliseconds. The full-text corpus answers in tens of seconds. Default 90000.

config.label: silent, error, info or debug
config.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
